Your holdings:

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the general sentiment around AI spending and tech earnings. Specifically, monitor the stops on your leveraged SOXL and SPAL positions, as well as SMH.

Focus on managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions, especially with potential market volatility ahead.
plays: Review SOXL: It's a leveraged "SELL" at -48.11%. Consider reducing exposure or setting a hard exit given the deep loss and decay.
